name: Call It Back Chant
why_it_works: Call-and-response turns the viewer into a participant: the gap after the call makes the brain fill in the answer. Once people answer once, they feel part of the crew and want to say it out loud at the game, the gym or the meet.

hook.pattern: A single voice shouts the call to camera, then a beat of silence that dares the viewer to answer.
examples: Only real {{crew_name}} fans know what comes next.

variables.name: call_word
variables.description: One or two punchy words the leader shouts

variables.name: response_word
variables.description: The one-word answer the crowd shouts back

variables.name: event
variables.description: Next game, meet, cruise night or class

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 low-angle photo of a {{crew_name}} leader mid-shout to camera, fist raised, stadium or parking-lot lights behind, high contrast night lighting
Vertical shot of a {{crew_name}} crowd throwing arms up and shouting together, handheld energy, colored rim lights, slight slow motion, 9:16
Tighter vertical close-up of the same leader shouting, sweat and grit, hard side light, {{crew_name}} colors on clothing
Quick vertical push-in on the {{crew_name}} crowd, bigger cheer, confetti or headlights flashing, 9:16

beats.purpose: tell them where to do it live

cta: Bring the noise to {{event}}, {{event_date}}. Comment {{response_word}} if you're coming.

craft.technique: Call-and-response chant with a planted rest
craft.notes: The call is two stressed syllables landing on beats 1 and 2; the response is one stressed syllable on beat 3, followed by a full beat of silence (beat 4) so it rings. Repeat the pair twice, the second time a half step higher or with more voices: repetition plus escalation. Keep the response a single word that is easy to shout with an open vowel (O, A). Tempo/feel: 92-96 BPM stomp-clap, marching drum or 808 stomp, no melody needed, the chant IS the hook.

do_not: Use a real team's or school's existing chant
Pick a response word that's hard to shout or sounds like an insult to a rival
Fill the silent gap with music; the gap is the hook
